diagram_math_checks.data: Outer C0 has centre (0,0), radius 2; left C1 and right C2 have centres (-1,0),(1,0), radii 1/2.
diagram_math_checks.justification: These are exactly the Example region and step 1.1. Distance 2 between hole centres exceeds the sum 1; each closed hole lies within radius 3/2 < 2. Naming the unordered inner pair left/right does not alter the original claim.

diagram_math_checks.relation: Outer arrow increases polar angle from 40 to 140 degrees; both inner arrows decrease polar angle from 120 to -140 degrees.
diagram_math_checks.justification: These are counterclockwise outer and clockwise inner tangents. Fact F2 and Verification 2.1 derive them from the outward-normal-first rule, also read directly in def-induced-boundary-orientation.

diagram_math_checks.relation: C1 disjoint-union C2 is incoming; C0 is outgoing; boundary orientation is -(C1 disjoint-union C2) disjoint-union C0.
diagram_math_checks.justification: Verification 3.1 and def-oriented-smooth-cobordism require the incoming induced orientation to be the negative of the source orientation and the outgoing induced orientation to agree with its target. The caption explicitly reserves counterclockwise orientation for source circles; arrows show induced boundary orientations.
